name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog:
* Updates itself: from this version on, new versions show on the Plugins screen and install with one click, like a plugin from the WordPress directory.
* Works beside the ClickUpLocal Brain Box, which now carries this same receiver: on a Brain Box site this plugin takes over when active, and deleting it keeps the connection code, history and backups the Brain Box's copy shares.
* Every text size on the settings page is 16px or larger, and messages use a colon where they had a dash.
